facts.fact: The Media Foundation for West Africa reports that editor Olivier Allochémé was arrested on 9 October 2025 and placed in pre-trial detention on 16 October 2025 by the CRIET for 'publishing false news via social media' in a Facebook editorial alleging President Talon had surveilled the former Speaker, with a hearing on 30 October 2025 adjourned to 15 January 2026.
